caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair with curved legs and ornate carvings, particularly at the top of the backrest, which includes a carved floral motif and a heart-shaped cutout in the center of the splat. The chair's seat is upholstered with a black fabric that has an embroidered floral design in shades of pink, red, brown, yellow, green, blue, and white. To the upper left of the chair, there is a separate depiction of the same black fabric with the embroidered floral design, shown flat and separately from the chair. The drawing predominantly uses naturalistic shades of brown for the wood, black for the fabric, and a variety of colors for the embroidered flowers. The background is a plain, light beige color. The artist’s name, "Robert Stewart," is written in the bottom right corner in brown text.
title: Walnut Carved Back Chair
